facts.fact: Libya Review reports the Ministry of Health and WHO met to assess DHIS2 digital reporting and expand it, with the Ministry stressing continuous data entry from all health institutions and DHIS2 indicators used nationally and regionally.

note: Lists strategy documents and a Health Number System only; states nothing on routine health reporting or a health management information system.
Document states nothing on health systems.
Judicial digitalisation recruitment notice; nothing stated for this study.
Meeting reviewed national health information systems but states no system under way, in service, linked or with published reporting rate.
The meeting only reviewed DHIS2 and WHO offered support; no procurement, pilot or service is stated.
Interview on prosecution digitisation and civil-registry forgery; nothing for this study.

systems.owner: National Center for the Development of the Health System

note: Only a health number system awaiting launch; no routine reporting system described.

facts.fact: DHIS2 has been the health management information system used in Libya since 2018 under the Ministry of Health's Health Information Centre, though it excludes community health data.
